subject: Next steps & scheduling: Partner marketplace technical deep-dive
content:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@partnercorp.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh@cloudmarket.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & scheduling: Partner marketplace technical deep-dive

Hi Maya / Rajesh —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap: you want a partner-led integration for PartnerCorp's marketplace listings, plus an automated billing telemetry flow to CloudMarket for usage attribution.
- Goals for the technical deep-dive: confirm integration points (catalog sync, SKU mapping), validate auth/KMS boundaries on private deployments, and agree on an initial staging timeline.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week. My team is available:
- Tue Apr 13: 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Apr 14: 14:00–15:30 PT
- Thu Apr 15: 08:30–10:00 PT

Can you confirm which of those windows works? If none, share 2–3 preferred slots and we’ll match. I’ve attached a short call prep doc (discovery-notes.pdf) and a draft demo outline we can expand once you confirm.

Agenda (draft):
1) 10m — Introductions & alignment on objectives
2) 20m — PartnerCorp architecture & data flow walkthrough (your side)
3) 20m — Redwood technical overview: marketplace connector + auth/KMS patterns
4) 10m — Q&A and immediate blockers / next milestones

If this looks good I’ll loop in our solutions engineer who can lead the demo portion.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (summary, 2 pages)

----
From: Maya Singh <maya@partnercorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@cloudmarket.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps & scheduling: Partner marketplace technical deep-dive

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear recap. Tue/Wed/Thu windows look fine in general; Rajesh and I prefer Wed Apr 14 at 14:00 PT. If that’s not possible for Redwood, Thu morning is our second choice.

A couple quick asks before the deep-dive:
- Can you share the connector auth flow diagram? We need to validate it with our security operations team.
- Will Redwood be able to show the catalog sync end-to-end (including SKU mapping examples)?

I’ll confirm with our security ops and loop them in if needed (likely Rajesh will be their point person). Happy to see the demo outline — will review and send changes.

Best,
Maya Singh
Partner Integrations Lead | PartnerCorp
maya@partnercorp.com | +44 20 8123 4456

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <maya@partnercorp.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh@cloudmarket.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & scheduling: Partner marketplace technical deep-dive

Stephanie / Maya —

We can do Wed Apr 14 14:00 PT. I’ll lead the demo portion and Jonas will cover the connector auth/KMS section. Stephanie — can you please book a 60-minute invite and include a short pre-read link? I attached the demo outline I’d like to use (demo-outline.md).

Key owners:
- Redwood demo lead: Vanessa Ortiz (solutions engineering)
- Connector/KMS: Jonas Weber (platform infra)
- Partner SE: Maya Singh (PartnerCorp)

On the auth flow diagram: Jonas, can you prepare a single-page sequence for the call (OIDC -> token exchange -> KMS envelope flow)? We’ll put that in the pre-read and share with PartnerCorp security ahead of time.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: 20270407-demo-outline.md

Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & scheduling: Partner marketplace technical deep-dive

All — confirmed Wed Apr 14, 14:00–15:00 PT. I’ve created the calendar invitation and attached the .ics. Pre-read: Vanessa’s demo outline + Jonas’s auth diagram (Jonas — can you drop the diagram link by EOD today?).

Meeting link / invite: https://app.redwood.ai/schedules/DL-2027-042
Doc pre-read: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/partnercorp-demo-outline
DocuSign (if we need an NDA before the call): https://rightsign.example.com/ndas/partnercorp

If anyone needs additional stakeholders from our side, flag now — otherwise we’ll keep it tight to respect PartnerCorp’s time.

Thanks,
Stephanie

Attachment: 20270408-calendar-invite.ics
